blocks.text: VALENCIA CITY, Bukidnon — City health officials here have sounded the alarm over a clustering of Hepatitis A cases allegedly linked to local barangay water systems, with six patients currently reported hospitalized. Cipriano Pat, City Health Disease Surveillance Officer who conducted an on-the-ground investigation, told the Inquirer on Friday that male patients aged 17 to 24 have been hospitalized, with five confined at a private hospital and one at a government facility. Pat noted that five of the positive Hepatitis A cases are neighbors in Barangay Lurugan. Hepatitis A is a liver inflammation caused by the Hepatitis A virus. Preliminary investigations […]...
